description: This is a test suite for the litellm project, specifically testing the unit behavior of text completion functionalities, including response parsing and API interactions. It contains multiple test cases using pytest, mocks external HTTP calls, and verifies the correctness of the response objects and request details.

classes.name: TextCompletionResponse
classes.description: A data structure representing the response from a text completion API, including choices, usage, and metadata.

methods.name: test_convert_dict_to_text_completion_response()
methods.description: Tests the conversion of a dictionary into a TextCompletionResponse object and verifies field correctness.

methods.name: test_huggingface_text_completion_logprobs()
methods.description: Validates the integration with Hugging Face API for text completion, focusing on logprobs structure and content.

methods.name: test_acompletion_uses_optimized_http_client()
methods.description: Checks that the asynchronous completion method uses the appropriate HTTP client from the internal utility method.
